case_families.name: eligibility_and_lifecycle
case_families.oracle: Disabled tuning/deterministic/disabled graph avoids managed work; eligible path after consumed legacy warmup performs tune then replay/capture callbacks.

case_families.name: skip_handoff
case_families.oracle: Resolved skips survive startup-to-graph handoff; cached explicit tactic is quarantined to -1 and skipped report, companion remains hit; true unskipped miss rejects.

case_families.name: reuse_off
case_families.oracle: Stable v1/managed files unchanged; existing legacy memory remains eligible; dirty snapshot isolated; graph tune/replay share one run identity; v1 save omits identified winners.

case_families.name: error_restoration
case_families.oracle: Failure restores effective controls, ambient identity and legacy choice; completion false; valid graph publications remain replayable.

environment.dependency_source: isolated virtual environment; local wheel cache except psutil 7.2.2 installed from package index

execution: fresh local CPU process; actual selected source modules; explicitly listed CUDA/import/metadata boundaries; controlled profiling times
limits: No GPU kernels or CUDA capture execution
No production integration or registered CI test

negative_controls.expected: nonzero assertion rejecting cached explicit winner instead of configured default
nonzero real strict replay miss after successful preparation

publication: Source and exact results on existing research branch; one living Markdown record outside public result directory.

reproduction.requirements: CPU Python 3.12, torch 2.14.1, msgspec 0.22.0, numpy 2.5.4, psutil 7.2.2; qualified FlashInfer source including the two pinned core hashes

source_roles.audit_flashinfer_scoped_handoff.py: research-only adapter with no production caller
source_roles.audit_flashinfer_scoped_handoff_controls: four real tuner/cache control families and faulty-adapter controls

validation: Frozen manual CPU checks plus expected-failure controls against faulty research adapter variants; applicable repository hooks; no production/test suite claims.
